Through: Mr. S.D.Pushkav, Adv.
 versus  THE STATE AND ANOTHER ..
 Through: Mr. Ajay Vikram Singh  State with SI Suman S  Rohini  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 20.03.2023 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 0419/2017 u/s 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS North Rohini Delhi.
The quashing is predicated on a settlement before Counselling Cell, Rohini Court dated 23.07.2019.
It is stated by Mr. S.D. Pushkav, learned counsel for the petitioner that respondent No. 2 is not cooperating in quashing and is not coming forward.
For the said reason, issue notice.
Mr. Singh, learned APP accepts notice on the petitioner taking steps within 1 week from today.
Notice be issued to respondent No. 2 through all modes, including electronic.
The notice shall indicate that respondent No. 2 should appear on the next date either physically or through VC along with a duly authorized advocate.
